instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Apex Precision Manufacturing is a medium-sized firm specializing in custom metal fabrication for the aerospace and automotive sectors. The company operates with a lean workforce and prides itself on high-quality, bespoke components.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company recently implemented workflow optimization software to reduce material waste by 15% and invested modestly in basic CNC machine upgrades to improve throughput.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary goal is to achieve a sustained 10% reduction in operational overhead through process streamlining. We aim to increase unit output per employee by automating repetitive tasks within the next three years.
answers.teamSize: The internal innovation team consists of four dedicated engineers and a project manager, working in close collaboration to drive change.

opportunities.title: Predictive Maintenance Integration for CNC Assets
opportunities.rationale: Integrating AI-driven sensor data from existing machinery can move maintenance from reactive to predictive, significantly reducing unexpected downtime and associated costs. This directly addresses the strategic priority of efficiency.

first_actions: Pilot sensor installation on the three most critical CNC machines.
Select a low-cost IoT platform for data ingestion.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in unplanned downtime by 20% within six months.
milestones: Q1: Sensor deployment and data baseline established.
Q3: Predictive alerts integrated into maintenance schedule.

opportunities.title: Robotic Assembly Cell Implementation (Cobots)
opportunities.rationale: Implementing collaborative robots for high-precision, repetitive assembly tasks offers a radical leap in efficiency and quality control. This requires a bold approach to talent acquisition but promises massive operational cost savings.

first_actions: Conduct a feasibility study on robotic integration costs vs. labor savings.
Establish partnerships with robotics vendors for pilot programs.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 30% reduction in direct labor hours for designated assembly lines.
milestones: Q2: Vendor selection and lab setup completed.
Q4: Pilot cell operational; ROI analysis finalized.

opportunities.title: Cross-Functional Lean Workflow Automation
opportunities.rationale: Using low-code automation tools to connect inventory, scheduling, and quality control data across departments will streamline internal processes. This is a low-cost, high-impact efficiency gain.

first_actions: Map the current end-to-end production process.
Identify three manual handoff points suitable for automation.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average order processing time by 15%.
milestones: Q2: Process mapping and tool selection finalized.
Q4: Automation tool live across two key departments.

next_steps.action: Initiate the feasibility study and vendor selection for the Predictive Maintenance project.
Form a cross-functional task force to evaluate capital expenditure for the Robotic Assembly Cell (Radical Opportunity).
Conduct an internal audit of current workflow bottlenecks and define scope for Lean Automation.

key_weaknesses: Reliance on manual data entry leading to high error rates.
Limited internal expertise in advanced automation and IoT integration.
Siloed communication between design, production, and maintenance teams.
Slow decision-making cycle for capital expenditure approval.
